post.title: GTA 6 Waited 13 Years. Then Login Failed. Here's Your Brain. #shorts
post.description: Grand Theft Auto VI unlocked at midnight ET on Nov 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, 13 years after GTA V. Around launch, players reported PlayStation Network sign-in errors, with thousands of Downdetector reports; Sony hasn't named a cause. Gus and Nell talk about the rosy view: Mitchell and colleagues (1997) found people rate vacations better before and after than during, so 13 years of imagining a perfect night was always going to beat the real one. Worth the wait, or ruined launch? Comment below. Sources: IBTimes UK (Nov 19, 2026); HappyGamer (Nov 19, 2026); XDA Developers (Nov 18, 2026).
